## Safety First

Do not include real customer, calendar, task, provider, token, email, webhook, callback URL, screenshot, export, or private workspace details. Use fictional examples only.

Do not request private private leadership-only behavior. ScheduleOS features must remain useful as standalone open-source functionality.

## Problem

What scheduling, calendar, or task-planning problem should this solve?

## Proposed Behavior

What should ScheduleOS do?

## Standalone Value

How would this help someone who is not using compatible leadership system, OwnerOps, ConnectOS, paid AI, hosted services, or commercial subscriptions?

## Integration Impact

Does this affect task sources, calendar providers, OwnerOps, ConnectOS, compatible leadership system, APIs, events, SDKs, or external applications?

## Privacy And Security Notes

What new data, permissions, tokens, provider scopes, external calls, retention needs, or write-back risks would this require?
